title: 3 Months / Level-1 Program
subtitle: Deep Space Exploration
description: Embark on a cosmic journey tailored for your young stargazers with our Deep Space Exploration Level 1 Program. Led by expert astronomers, this immersive experience unveils the wonders of the universe, igniting curiosity and inspiring a lifelong passion for discovery. Join us as we guide your child through the mysteries of deep space, sparking their imagination and nurturing their love for astronomy.
topics: Solar System Exploration & Planetary Science
Stargazing & Constellation Identification
Moon Phases, Lunar Eclipses & Tides
Introduction to Telescopes & Space Optics
The Birth and Life Cycle of Stars
Interactive Quizzes & Hands-on Sky Observation Activities

title: 12 months / level-2 program
subtitle: Junior Astronomer Program –
description: Our Junior Astronomer Program is designed for curious young minds who are ready to journey beyond the basics of space. This level introduces kids to fascinating topics like black holes, rockets, exoplanets, life in space, quantum science, robotics in astronomy, neutrino exploration, plasma physics, and the mysterious forces that shape our universe. With interactive teaching sessions, hands-on experiments, fun quizzes, and visual learning tools, students develop critical thinking while understanding real scientific concepts in a simplified, playful way. Each topic is carefully curated to blend imagination with scientific facts, making learning both exciting and meaningful.
topics: Black Holes, Event Horizons & Gravitational Singularities
Rocket Science, Orbital Mechanics & Propulsion Systems
Exoplanets & The Search for Extraterrestrial Life
Life in Space & Human Spaceflight Biology
Quantum Science & Atomic Foundations of the Cosmos
Robotics in Astronomy, Rovers & Deep Space Probes
Neutrino Astronomy & High Energy Particle Physics
Plasma Physics & Solar Magnetic Dynamos

title: 12 months / level-3 program
subtitle: Career-Oriented Advance Astronomy and Astrophysics Program
description: Prepare your child for a future among the stars with our Career-Oriented 12-Month Advance Astronomy and Astrophysics Program. Led by industry-leading experts, this comprehensive journey equips students with the specialized knowledge and skills needed for a successful career in space science. From advanced celestial mechanics to cutting-edge research methodologies, our program empowers young astronomers to reach for the cosmos and pursue their dreams among the galaxies. Join us as we launch your child's career into the infinite possibilities of the universe.
topics: Advanced Celestial Mechanics & Orbital Dynamics
Theoretical Astrophysics & Cosmology Equations
Spectroscopy & Stellar Evolution Models
Radio Astronomy & Space Telemetry Data Analysis
Python for Astronomical Data & Research Analysis
Space Mission Design & Satellite Engineering
Career Pathways: ISRO, NASA, ESA & Space Tech Startups
Research Paper Guidance & Mentorship from Space Scientists
